Prepare step by step

  1. Confirm the vehicle identity, title and history through responsible sources.
  2. Compare total out-the-door price, financing terms and optional add-ons separately.
  3. Arrange an independent inspection where appropriate.
  4. Read every written term before signing and keep pressure or verbal promises distinct from the contract.

General safety, records and service preparation only; no repair diagnosis, valuation, insurance coverage, legal or purchase recommendation.
